met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Sri Ganganagar, Hissar, Moradabad, Gorakhpur, Muzaffarpur, Balurghat and thence east-southeastwards to Manipur.
The Western Disturbance as cyclonic circulation now lies over central Pakistan & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level with a trough aloft in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level runs roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 32°N.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over South Bangladesh & neighbourhood now lies over North Bay of Bengal & adjoining South Bangladesh between 4.5 & 5.8 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over East Bangladesh & neighbourhood and extends upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
A Trough runs from North west Bihar to Manipur across upper air cyclonic circulation over East Bangladesh & Tripura at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Bihar & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Assam & neighbourhood between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
The trough in westerlies roughly along Long. 89°E to the north of Lat. 21°N upto 1.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
